rounds.response:
Morgan — dashboards/metrics to validate for the demo: Overview dashboard (DAU, new signups, active users, session count); Feature X funnel (step counts, conversion %, time-to-activation for the demo flow); Revenue/plan-change dashboard (upgrades count, MRR delta, upgrade conversion rate); Ingestion/health dashboard (events received, ingestion latency, dedupe rate, lost-event alerts).  
Risks (assumptions in parentheses): 1) Timing — if discrepancies require engineering fixes, demo readiness may slip (assume fixes take >1 business day); 2) Data completeness — if staging samples or dropped events reduce observed events below 95% of expected, metric reconciliation will be unreliable (assume staging traffic patterns approximate production); 3) Definition drift — mismatched metric definitions between dashboards and canonical spec could produce false mismatches (assume canonical metric definitions are final).  
Alex — mandatory checks for your 2:00–3:00pm slot: run the four synthetic scenarios, confirm events appear in raw_events with correct event_name and required properties, capture ingestion timestamp and dedupe key for a sample of events, and verify ingestion latency <2 minutes; nice-to-have: full row-level parity checks in transformed tables, run duplicate/intermittent-network edge cases.  
Riley — treat >2% variance as blocking only for priority/demo metrics (DAU, the demo funnel conversion steps, and upgrade/MRR figures); for secondary metrics, log variances >2% in the shared sheet and annotate but do not block the demo.  
Action: Alex runs the mandatory checks this afternoon and logs results in the shared validation sheet, Riley runs dashboard reconciliations tomorrow and flags any blocking issues, and we convene EOD tomorrow to triage outstanding discrepancies.
